name: CodeViewer diff view refactor
description:
# Summary of Conversation

1. **Refactored CodeViewer component** to make the diff view the default display for existing files with changes, automatically activated when code generation finishes.

2. **Simplified diff workflow** by removing the "Save changes" button and keeping only "Discard changes" action, with a unified "Save" button in the header actions.

3. **Added automatic file type detection** to distinguish between new and existing files, enabling smart diff view activation only for files that already exist in the project.

4. **Improved user experience** for quick code review and edits by streamlining the action buttons and making the diff view the primary interface for reviewing changes on existing files.

5. **Maintained component structure** following Vue 3 composition API conventions with script setup, template, and script sections using TailwindCSS styling without external CSS files.

messages.content:
The diff will be the default view when block shows changes on an existing file, if not keep as it is. Only load diff when block is done and switch to diff if not new file.
in the diff view remove the "save changes", keeo only "Discard changes",  and show the "Save" button as well with the diff.


The goal is to  quickly review changes, make small changes if needed and save the file.
